title: Nice

title: Good
body: It's good—the app works quite well, though there is a bit of a wait for results. I'm not sure if it's due to the network or something else, but overall, it's pretty solid.

title: This app changed my life
body: For years I have been suffered from procrastination, never completed anything meaningful, but it all changed from the day I try to organize my life with this app. It has everything I wanted from a habit tracker app, from intuitive and easy to use daily routine setup, to beautiful journaling that encourages me to keep trying everyday to improve myself. On top of that is a modern and beautiful UI. Can’t recommend this app enough!
author: chutneyyy
